selection: Within each outer training set,rank64 candidates by inner source-weightedMAE,RMSE,ID. Best representative of each9 families. Primary averages family representatives within winnerMAE+SE,SE=sampleSD(per-source innerMAE)/sqrt(G). All8 original families plus RidgeGP retained; old/new/six/shape family winners and joint winner reported; never replace primary using outer scores.
preprocessing: Train-only: same eligibility >=3 sources and15% rows,unweighted median imputation; same original log1p fields; center transformed training median,divideIQR; IQR<=1e-9 falls back to training populationSD or1. Apply smoothasinh. Shape/missing indicators multiplied.25,static/onehot/missing.5,early1. Values/labels never edited or clipped.
GPR_weighting: alpha_i=base_alpha/(source_weight_i*n_train); deliberate source-balanced diagonal regularization,not measured noise variance. FixedMaternnu1.5,optimizerNone. Targetcenter/scale and nonGP sample_weight also source-balanced.
hybrid: Ridge(alpha10) fits standardized delta target ontraining only; MaternGP fits in-sample training residuals with source diagonal regularization. Prediction=sum of mean and residual;2 estimator fits per pipeline. Inner/outer source isolation covers both stages. No copied battery monotonic constraint.
generalization: At least10 development source families and genuinely new untouched external-source validation; reuse of these development sources alone never achieves reliable-model acceptance.
scope: Exactly P9 cohorts/rows/author targets/windows; no raw-point new descriptors. Six/shape both remain permitted,2E/3E independent.2point proposal still not applied. A/P6 histories remain.
scientific_status: Exploratory adaptive development round after exposed previous results. Not untouched external confirmation. Robust scaling/source regularization may help but is not presumed successful.
